summary.text: Meg Froelich is a Democrat who represents District 3 (Arapahoe and Denver counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where she took office on January 14, 2019, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her as not running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Froelich was born in Houston, Texas, earned a bachelor's degree in history from Bryn Mawr College in 1985 and a master's degree in history from the University of Michigan in 1989.
Her career included work as a documentary filmmaker and as executive director of the Colorado Institute for Leadership Training, Ballotpedia says.
